author: integrated_case_peer
genre: Research communication/revision instruction; original two-case/eight-solution package with elementary exact counterfactual arithmetic, not a new technical graduate theorem chapter.

coverage_review.presentation: Complete proposed ten-minute spoken script, two visual aids, explicit timing/rehearsal limits, question/evidence/warrant/conclusion architecture.
coverage_review.questions: Seven direct complete responses: causal gap, denominator, restriction credibility, sample size, alternative channel, unknown data, invalid zero-effect inference.
coverage_review.response_memo: Three substantive comments answered with accepted corrections, exact replacement text/locations, declined extension and honest editorial/contribution consequences.
coverage_review.revision: Original false excerpt, revised title/abstract/method/conclusion, disposition matrix, all dependent claims removed; withdrawal distinguished from identification repair.
coverage_review.defense: Unfamiliar wider bound derived with feasible endpoint worlds; changed borrower target distinguished from summing bank effects; contribution defended only within stated scope.
coverage_review.disagreement: Concede consequential objections, reject invalid inference rather than attack motives; beyond-scope valid only after withdrawing dependent claims.

full_reading.case1: Read every spoken segment, calculation sheet and seven question/answer exchanges. Units/equal weighting/perimeter, anticipation/comparator assumptions, observed growth versus normalized contrast, untreated-trend decomposition, compatible worlds, interval endpoint reversal and no-confidence-level limits checked. Timing is proposed, not a fabricated rehearsal.
full_reading.case2: Read original and all replacement paragraphs, three full memo responses, four disposition rows, three defense exchanges and assessment protocol. Sensitivity bounds remain hypothetical; all endpoint worlds feasible; no learner achievement, research novelty, mechanism, policy or welfare established.
full_reading.exercises: All eight exact prompts and full solutions read: opening; all means and percentages; equal-level fallacy; bound credibility/sharp endpoints; response plus replacement text; changed bound/borrower target; principled disagreement; partial observed performance, false validation, remediation and unseen reassessment. No rubric-only substitute for an answer.
full_reading.teachback_retention: Both actual prompts matched to complete answer guides; widening bounds enlarges a compatible set and does not prove zero; actual retention performance must be observed.
full_reading.sources: Read canonical V13C12 scope record; reuse only dated methodological writing/referee guidance, with unnamed original-inspector limit and inherited pages/images explicit. No fresh body inspection claimed. All demonstrations and protocol original.
full_reading.limits: Author internal review only. Separate peer/root acceptance pending. No actual empirical finding, learner defense, institutional credential, new source-body reading or rendered UI verification.

numerical_method: Exact Fraction calculations from every actual visible input/result; independently re-add potential-outcome identity, construct endpoints/interior worlds, three alternative observed tables, ten explicit invalid-domain guards. Complete qualitative reading separate from checker counts.

result.qualitative_review: Complete talk, response memo, all eight solutions and human-assessment limits separately read; arithmetic does not certify those judgments.
